{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|Darklighters believe in treating friends like family and family like friends, and we're always glad to add yet one more to the family.|Jula Darklighter|<ref name="BW">''[[X-Wing: The Bacta War]]''</ref>}}
The '''Darklighter family''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] family native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], descended from [[Daggath Darklighter]] of [[Cerea/Legends|Cerea]].<ref name="Disapproval">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20041223|text=Disapproval|int=Disapproval}}</ref> Its members included:

*[[Huff Darklighter]]
*Unnamed [[Gender/Legends|female]], [[Biggs Darklighter's mother/Legends|Huff's first wife]]
*Unnamed female, [[Huff Darklighter's second wife|Huff's second wife]]
*[[Lanal Darklighter]], Huff's third wife
**[[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter]], Huff's son from his first marriage
**[[Dera Darklighter]], Huff's daughter from his second marriage
*[[Jula Darklighter]], Huff's brother
*[[Silya Darklighter]], Jula's wife, Lanal's sister
**[[Rasca Darklighter]], their daughter
**[[Anya Darklighter]], their daughter
**[[Gavin Darklighter]], their son
**[[Sera Faleur Darklighter]], Gavin's wife
*A [[Huff Darklighter's niece|niece]] of Huff Darklighter<ref name="SWG:HD">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|Huff Darklighter|Tatooine}}</ref>
*[[Trepler Darklighter]]<ref name="GG7">''[[Galaxy Guide 7: Mos Eisley]]''</ref>

Gavin Darklighter adopted two sons following the end of the [[Thrawn campaign]]. He later married the social worker, Sera Faleur, who helped him through the adoption process, and they had three biological children: first a daughter, then a son, then another daughter.<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Characters">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|Biggs's death shook Huff. He decided he wanted more heirs. His second wife decided she wasn't interested in having any more than the one she'd already borne. She left, and Huff married me.|Lanal Darklighter|<ref name="BW" />}}
The most well-known Darklighter was Biggs Darklighter, friend of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], and pilot of a [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. His wingmen included his old friend Luke and [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]]. Unfortunately, Biggs met his death when [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] opened fire on him while he was flanking Luke in the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] trench.<ref name="Episode 4">{{Film|IV}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The first mention of anyone named Darklighter is in the person of [[Seig Darklighter]], commonly believed to be the leader of the [[Showdown on Coruscant|Jedi Rebellion]], in the [[The Star Wars rough draft|rough draft]] of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Episode IV'']]. The name Darklighter again appears in the [[Adventures of the Starkiller, Episode I: The Star Wars|second draft]]. This draft tells the story of a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] who abandons his [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] after coming under the influence of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] (referred to as the Bogan).<ref name="The Making of Star Wars: The Definitive Story Behind the Original Film">''[[The Making of Star Wars: The Definitive Story Behind the Original Film]]''</ref>

A man named "Darklighter" served at [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on the planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. He [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|evacuated]] Hoth aboard the [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transport]] [[Bright Hope/Legends|''Bright Hope'']], the final transport to escape the planet. After the transport was disabled trying to run the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] blockade, he reached the planet [[Darlyn Boda/Legends|Darlyn Boda]] with the other surviving members of the ship, before being one of just six of those survivors to finally reach the secret [[Haven (rendezvous point)|Rebel rendezvous point]] due to his importance to the Rebellion. He served aboard the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] [[Redemption/Legends|''Redemption'']] immediately thereafter. It is unknown if this man is related to the Tatooinian Darklighter family.<ref name="Of Possible Futures: The Tale of Zuckuss and 4-LOM">{{StoryCite|story=Of Possible Futures: The Tale of Zuckuss and 4-LOM|book=Tales of the Bounty Hunters}}</ref>
